free_tier.stated: Free 'basic' plan is 10 uploads/month with a per-model cap that the two official pages disagree on: /features says 50 MB for Free / 200 MB Pro / 500 MB Premium, while the /plans comparison table renders 100 MB / 200 MB / 500 MB for basic / pro / custom. Either way the Free cap is 50–100 MB per model (mesh + textures + everything), so the ambiguity does not change the verdict. A model marked downloadable does not count against the monthly upload count.

retention.stated: Per-object-cap 50–100 MB free (docs conflict, see quota); the binding constraint is the request-rate equivalent of 10 uploads/month; retention is indefinite but content is re-processed into a viewer pipeline, so byte-exactness of textures is not guaranteed for display purposes.

egress.terms: Free and CDN-served; the original file is retrievable when the author enables download, and there is a Viewer API and oEmbed/iframe embedding. No egress pricing.

record.tooling: Documented REST API with bulk upload support ('Bulk uploads: Via API'); community Python/js clients; glTF/OBJ/FBX/PLY/STL and ~25 other formats accepted.
record.chaining: 10 uploads/month x ~50–100 MB = 0.5–1 GB/month per account, and the cap only applies to models left non-downloadable. Multiplying accounts is the only path, and the per-object cap never rises above 100 MB.

record.reliability_note: Commercial 3D asset hosting platform with restrictive monthly upload count quotas and small per-file upload caps. Models may be unlisted or disabled by platform moderators.

evidence.proved: 'Max upload size: 50MB for Free accounts, 200MB for Pro accounts, 500MB for Premium accounts'; 'Bulk uploads: Via API'
